research_types.name: Market Research
research_types.when: Market opportunity, customers, competition, sizing, or go-to-market for a product or business decision.

research_types.name: Domain Research
research_types.when: Understanding an industry, sector, or field: structure, players, rules, vocabulary, dynamics.

research_types.name: Technical Research
research_types.when: A technology area's landscape, patterns, integration approaches, and implementation reality.

research_types.name: Competitive Research
research_types.when: Teardown of specific named competitors: offers, pricing, positioning, trajectory, their customers' sentiment.

research_types.name: User-Voice Research
research_types.when: What users of a product or category actually experience and want: reviews, communities, jobs-to-be-done.

research_types.name: Academic Literature
research_types.when: Published research: literature review, state of the art, grounding an approach in papers.
